name: GridCraft R
description: R in GridCraft: R code in formulas, ready-made statistics (linear models, t-tests, quantiles, correlations, summaries), R scripts, plots and a console. Needs R 3.4 or later (Rscript on PATH); no packages.
author: Marco Montanari

functions.name: R.EVAL
functions.description: Runs R code with the arguments as x, y, z (all of them: args, ..1, ..2...). A range is a matrix. Trusted workbooks only

functions.name: R.CALL
functions.description: Calls an R function by name ("median", "stats::mad") with the arguments. Trusted workbooks only

functions.name: R.LM
functions.description: Linear model y ~ x (one or more columns of x): a spilled table of coefficients, std. errors, t and p values, R squared, F

functions.name: R.QUANTILE
functions.description: Quantiles with R's nine definitions (type 1-9, default 7). One probability gives a number, several a spilled table (default: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)

functions.name: R.CORR
functions.description: Correlation matrix of the columns, with labels: method "pearson" (default), "spearman" or "kendall"; headers TRUE takes the names from the first row

functions.name: R.TTEST
functions.description: Student's t-test (Welch for two samples): a spilled table of t, df, p value, 95% confidence interval and means

functions.name: R.SUMMARY
functions.description: Per-column summary like R's summary(): n, missing, min, quartiles, median, mean, max, std. dev. (spills)

commands.label: Run R Script
commands.description: Runs R code on the selection (x) and writes the result below it or on a new sheet
commands.params: {code? | file?, header?: bool, output?: below|sheet} (no params: asks)

commands.label: R Plot
commands.description: Draws a base R plot of the selection (x) and inserts it as a picture
commands.params: {code?, header?: bool, width?, height?} (no params: asks)

commands.label: R Console
commands.description: Evaluates R code in R's workspace and shows the result

commands.label: Trust This Workbook
commands.description: Turns R code on for the active workbook, after spelling out the risk

commands.label: Trust This Workbook (confirmed)
commands.description: Trusts the active workbook without asking (what Trust This Workbook's OK runs)
commands.params: {path, name, id}: the active workbook's (context.document), as a check

commands.label: Stop Trusting
commands.description: Turns R code off for the active workbook

commands.label: Trusted Workbooks
commands.description: Lists the trusted workbooks, to take some off the list

commands.label: Remove Trusted Workbooks
commands.description: Takes workbooks off the trusted list

commands.label: About R
commands.description: R version, R_HOME, installed packages and whether R is on for this workbook
